title: Barbie 2 Will Have to Start from Scratch if Warner Bros. Can't Make a Deal With Talent by December
description: Negotiations for Barbie 2 have come to a halt, and if Warner Bros. can't make a deal by December 2026, it will lose director Greta Gerwig, writer Noah Baumbach, and stars Margot Robbie and Ryan Gosling.

title: The Best Deals Today: LEGO Pokémon, DDR5 RAM, Death Stranding 2, and More
Palworld TCG Prices Skyrocket as eBay Scalpers Profit Off of Card Game Launch
description: The Palworld TCG has officially launched, and so too has a wave of scalpers looking to make a quick buck on developer Pocketpair's new collectible cards.
